name: University of Ottawa
summary: Bilingual university in Canada's capital: study in English, French or both, with more than 350 undergraduate programs and co-op.

handoff.label: How to apply: programs and deadlines

ib.text: The IB Diploma counts as the equivalent of the Ontario high school diploma; each program sets its own minimum average and prerequisites. Check them in uOttawa's admission-requirements tool for your program.

noDeadline: Most programs close in May; competitive ones fill earlier

dates.label: Recommended date to submit your application
All application requirements, documents and test results, or 30 days after you apply

programmes.name: Commerce (Telfer School of Management)
programmes.about: A management degree at the Telfer School in downtown Ottawa, with options aligned to accounting, finance, HR and analytics designations, and a co-op route. Streams run in English, French or French immersion.
programmes.ib: English, Advanced Functions-level Maths and one more maths course (Calculus or Statistics) are the prerequisites; a mid-80s average is typically needed.
programmes.selectionNote: Competitive: a mid-80s average is typically required, on Ontario's scale (no IB points given); 1,200 to 1,300 first-year places across streams. Co-op spaces are limited.

flagshipSource.title: Telfer BCom FAQ: first-year class of 1,200 to 1,300 and options aligned to professional designations

programmes.name: Political Science
programmes.about: Four subfields at the School of Political Studies: political thought, Canadian and Quebec politics, comparative politics, and international relations. Offered in English and French, with a co-op placing students with federal employers in the capital.
programmes.ib: Direct admission to the co-op stream needs a minimum average of 80% on Ontario's scale; ask uOttawa for the IB equivalent.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on grades; the average is on Ontario's scale and uOttawa gives no IB conversion. Co-op places go to the highest CGPA first and are limited.

flagshipSource.title: Political Science co-op: placements with Global Affairs Canada, Health Canada and other federal employers

notes: uOttawa teaches in English, French or both. English-language programs need proof of English only if you have not studied three years full-time in English; for French-language programs it asks for French.
